environment: Document audit of [Ope26] and [Boc26], Python 3.12, macOS darwin, commit 675ad3e
summary: Completed a claim-by-claim audit of Theorem D.1: confirmed soundness of bipartite edge subdivision, verified exact integer counting in Z_{2^{s+1}}, and documented the critical non-operational threshold u_0 = floor(b / 2^{17}).
notes: No internal reduction gap found between Theorem D.1 and Theorem 4. However, Theorem D.1 requires network size s >= 2^{2^{17}} and u_0 = floor(b / 2^{17}) >= 1 before achieving any speedup, rendering the algorithm non-applicable to deployed curves (NIST P-256, Ed25519) under generic bounds.
